group: Gundam Universal Century (0083 Stardust Memory, Zeta Gundam, Char's Counterattack); also Lady Une (Gundam Wing) on request

entries.personality: Hot-tempered and rash, often questions orders; mobile suit otaku; fiercely protective of those close to him; driven to surpass his rival Gato.
entries.notes: Wiki title "Kou Uraki". Not "Ko"/"Kō".
entries.role: Protagonist of 0083; 19-year-old Earth Federation test pilot from Torrington Base assigned to the Albion; pilots Gundam GP01 (later GP03 Dendrobium). Rank: Ensign.

entries.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.
entries.notes: CONTESTED: variants "Gatoh"/"Gatou" (romanizations of the long vowel in ガトー, seen in some fan translations and games). Wiki page title and official English use "Anavel Gato"; there is no wiki page or redirect for "Gatoh". Use "Gato".
entries.role: Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).

entries.personality: Withdrawn, machine-obsessed teen in the original series; by CCA a mature, dependable veteran still bound up in his rivalry with Char.
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack (also Mobile Suit Gundam, Zeta Gundam)
entries.role: Earth Federation ace Newtype pilot; in CCA a Londo Bell mobile suit team leader (Captain) aboard the Ra Cailum and pilot of the Nu Gundam; Char's lifelong rival.

entries.personality: Charismatic, highly respected leader with a cold, ruthless side; mentally fragile, burdened by his father Zeon Zum Deikun's legacy.
entries.notes: In CCA his title is 総帥 (Sosui, Supreme Commander/Supreme Leader); the wiki infobox lists "Marshal [CCA]".
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack (also Mobile Suit Gundam, Zeta Gundam)
entries.role: "Red Comet"; in CCA the supreme leader of Neo Zeon who plans to drop Axis on Earth; pilots the Sazabi from the Rewloola.

entries.personality: Talented and obsessively devoted to her Gundams; annoyed by Kou's childishness at first, then grows close to him.
entries.role: Anaheim Electronics systems engineer on the Gundam Development Project, assigned to the Albion with GP01; Gato's former lover and Kou's love interest.

entries.personality: Grizzled veteran with a commanding presence and keen tactical mind; relies on his own judgement and sense of right and wrong.
entries.notes: CONTESTED: the widely used spelling is "Eiphar Synapse" (G Generation wiki, Behind The Voice Actors, the Gundam Wiki's own image filenames). The Gundam Wiki page title is "Eyphar Sinapus" and "Eiphar Synapse" redirects to it. Under "the wiki wins": "Eyphar Sinapus" / short "Sinapus". Flag for human review because "Synapse" is far more familiar to fans.
entries.role: Earth Federation captain (Captain, 大佐) of the assault carrier Albion; leads the pursuit of the stolen GP02.

entries.personality: Experienced, strict but fatherly mentor to the young pilots. (The wiki personality section is empty; this is inferred from his role on the wiki.)
entries.notes: Spelling is high confidence; the personality note is thin because the wiki section is blank.
entries.role: Veteran Earth Federation pilot (Captain, 大尉), leader of the Burning Team on the Albion and Kou's mentor; KIA 8 Nov 0083.

entries.personality: Minor bridge crew character; the wiki gives no personality information.
entries.notes: CONTESTED: katakana シモン reads directly as "Simon"; the wiki page title is "Jacqueline Simone" and "Jacqueline Simon" redirects to it (her image filename uses "Simon"). Wiki wins: "Simone".
entries.ja: ジャクリーヌ・シモン
entries.role: Albion bridge operator (radar/sensors, port side), Warrant Officer; later assigned to the Titans.

entries.personality: Least experienced of the bridge crew; very conscientious and dutiful.
entries.role: Albion bridge radar operator, Warrant Officer; later Titans.

entries.personality: Reform-minded, determined officer who does everything he can against Operation Stardust despite political opposition.
entries.notes: CONTESTED: variant "Kowen" exists (the wiki's own image is "John Kowen.png"; "John Kowen" redirects). Wiki page title "John Cowen" wins. Wiki rank: Rear Admiral (0079), Vice Admiral (0083), then demoted to Rear Admiral.
entries.role: Earth Federation Vice Admiral (中将), commander of the 3rd Earth Orbital Fleet and head of the Gundam Development Project; reformist forced out during Operation Stardust.

entries.personality: Scheming, harsh and venomous, intolerant of failure, yet decisive and fiercely loyal to her own men; embittered by how Zeon used her and her homeland Mahal.
entries.notes: CONTESTED: "Sima"/"Seema"/"Shima" appear in fan translations; the wiki title and official English use "Cima" (there is no wiki page for "Sima Garahau"). Use "Cima".
entries.role: Commander of the Cima Fleet (ex-Zeon marines); allied with the Delaz Fleet, then betrays it to the Federation; pilots the Gelgoog Marine Commander Type and Gerbera Tetra. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel (中佐).

entries.personality: Zealous idealist devoted to Spacenoid independence and Gihren's cause; stern but paternal toward Gato; dies shouting "Sieg Zeon".
entries.notes: CONTESTED: variants "Eguille Delaz", "Egiyu Delaz", "Deraz". Wiki title "Aiguille Delaz" (no wiki redirect for "Eguille Delaz"). The faction name follows it: "Delaz Fleet".
entries.role: Leader of the Delaz Fleet and mastermind of Operation Stardust; former Zeon colonel loyal to Gihren Zabi. Wiki rank: Lieutenant General (0083).

entries.personality: Split personality: a cold, ruthless military persona and a gentle, pacifist persona that eventually wins out; utterly devoted to Treize.
entries.notes: Added at coordinator request (may duplicate the Gundam Wing group). The in-game short label was not given; "Une" is a suggestion. Spelled "Une" (from French "une"), not "Anne"/"Ann".

entries.role: Treize Khushrenada's aide and OZ Space Force commander (Second-Class Special Colonel); after the war, leader of the Preventer organization (Endless Waltz).

entries.role: The former Zeon fortress Solomon, renamed by the Federation; site of the 0083 naval review that Gato attacks.

entries.notes: Also an episode title ("La Vie en Rose (episode)").

Federation base in eastern Australia where Gato steals GP02.
Delaz Fleet headquarters hidden in the debris shoal of former Side 5.

entries.notes: Naval: Ensign / army: Second Lieutenant. Kou Uraki's wiki infobox says "Ensign" (Chuck Keith too). Use "Ensign" for the Albion crew. NAVAL vs ARMY: the wiki rank tables (EFF and Zeon pages) give two columns, "Space Units" (naval titles) and "Ground Units" (army titles), and the Zeon page says space forces use naval ranks and ground forces army ranks. Character infoboxes do not follow this consistently: EFF ship officers get naval titles (Ensign, Captain = 大佐, Vice Admiral), while EFF MS pilots and nearly all Zeon officers get army titles (Captain = 大尉, Major, Lieutenant Colonel, Lieutenant General), even in space.
